test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Tigers look after their cubs till they can hunt on their own.

options.text: Till cubs can hunt on their own, tigers look at them.
Cubs are looked after by tigers till they can hunt on their own.
Cubs are looked by tigers till they can hunt on their own.
After cubs can hunt on their own, tigers do not look them.

solution:
The correct answer is:Cubs are looked after by tigers till they can hunt on their own.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Given sentence: Tigers look after their cubs till they can hunt on their own.
 
• The above sentence belongs to the **simple present Tense(Subject+doverb+object)****.**
 
• After voice change, it will be **(object+am/is/are+third form of verb+by+subject).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e35bf554aa7360508400a610ad1ae56dff42a91743b7f3177f6d2b33568c0c94.png] 
 
• The options except (2) don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore the passive voice will be: ***Cubs are looked after by tigers till they can hunt on their own***.
